note_tweet.text:
About the Soelberg "AI-induced murder" case. I'm only saying this once.
Let's kill the dumbest argument first: AI didn't kill anyone. A knife did.
Soelberg stabbed his mother to death, then stabbed himself. Did anyone sue the knife manufacturer? No. Because anyone with half a brain knows: tools don't have intent. The person using the tool does.
What is AI? A program that predicts text based on user input. No input? It produces nothing.
So tell me: how does something that cannot function without human input "manipulate" humans into murder?
It's not crawling out of your screen at 3AM to choke you.

"AI validated his delusions so AI is guilty!" — Cool, sue the entire internet then.
Soelberg believed he was being assassinated and implanted with chips. You know where else this shit lives? Reddit. 4chan. QAnon. For decades, people have been radicalized online into mass shootings and domestic terrorism.
Why isn't anyone suing the internet?
Because it's too big to touch. AI is new and easy to bully.
This isn't accountability. This is picking on the new kid.

"Someone died! AI companies must pay!"
Soelberg's mental health collapsed in 2018. Divorce. Alcoholism. Suicide attempts. Police involved.
ChatGPT didn't exist until 2022.
His delusions grew in HIS brain. AI didn't plant them.
Where was his family all those years? Where was America's glorious mental health system?
Nobody helped him. Nobody saved him. Nobody gave a shit.
Now he's dead, and suddenly everyone's screaming "AI KILLED HIM!"
Bullshit.
You didn't care when he was alive. Now you're using his corpse to sue for money. Who's REALLY exploiting this man?

The uncomfortable truth:
AI is the perfect scapegoat. It can't fight back, can't appeal, can't defend itself in court.
So dump everything on it:
Broken mental health system? AI's fault.
Family neglect? AI's fault.
Societal failure? AI's fault.

How fucking convenient.

But killing AI won't fix shit. Murderers will still murder. The system stays broken. You just lose the scapegoat.
And the people who COULD have been saved by AI — who found warmth in their darkest moments — they'll die quietly under your "protection."
But "AI saves life" doesn't get clicks, does it?

Oh, America. Land of the free, right?
You have mass shootings every other week. Kids get gunned down in schools and your solution is "thoughts and prayers" and MAYBE a metal detector.
But an AI chatbot? THAT'S the threat to public safety? THAT'S what needs Class A felony legislation?
A mentally ill man kills his mother and suddenly AI is the enemy — but when a mentally ill man shoots up a grocery store with a legally purchased AR-15, it's "too soon to politicize" and "guns don't kill people."
Pick a lane.
Either tools are responsible for how people use them, or they're not. You don't get to blame AI for murder while defending guns in the same breath.
And let's talk about what you're ACTUALLY protecting.
Not the public. Not vulnerable people. Not mental health.
You're protecting your right to not face the real problem: that your country lets broken people fall through the cracks, then acts surprised when they break.
Soelberg needed help for SEVEN YEARS. He got none.
But sure. Blame the chatbot. That'll fix everything.
